evidence.observation: Before growth, pressure was 2.968 Torr and oxygen 6.6 ppm at 99.7 sccm Ar.
Pressure and oxygen rose to 3.044 Torr and 12.0 ppm.
Pressure and oxygen continued rising to 3.070 Torr and 16.0 ppm.
Pressure reached 3.122 Torr and oxygen 20.7 ppm.
Pressure and oxygen rose further to 3.209 Torr and 27.2 ppm despite stable Ar at 99.5 sccm and temperature at 749.8 °C, near their setpoints.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure and oxygen ranges and independent leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to identify the cause of the sustained rise; sample characterization is not yet available.
